title: Graffiti Traffic Sign
description: Use this service request to report graffiti on traffic signs. The estimated response time (ERT) for this request is 5 business days.

observedQuestions.question: Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: Graffiti on Sign; sign type = Other with description; direction = Westbound; contact = No; Details Continue reached Contact

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to report graffiti on a traffic sign or signal.
actions.why: For graffiti on a traffic sign, including stop, do-not-enter, lane designation, parking, school-zone, speed-limit, street-name, and other signs. The 311 request form also offers Signal as a graffiti-location answer and suggests the current service for that answer. It asks for the sign type, direction, and a description when Other is selected.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Graffiti Traffic Sign"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Traffic Signs and Signals" > Choose "Graffiti Traffic Sign"
